auxiliary_intermediate_forces: Preserved but excluded from all primary metrics and claim decisions
metrics: full-task success rate by task, mass, and force
posterior predicted p_success by task, mass, and force
checkpoint_selection: Minimum VAL posterior NLL per frozen seed; TRAIN and VAL only

claim_rules.COARSE_MASS_CONDITIONED_FEASIBILITY: SUPPORTED only if frozen model qualification passes and heldout predictions or outcomes vary informatively with mass; MIXED for inconsistent task cuts; NOT_SUPPORTED if qualification fails.
claim_rules.COARSE_ADAPTIVE_FORCE_ALLOCATION: SUPPORTED only if heldout mean predicted p5-p3 is nonnegative and model qualification passes; MIXED if aggregate sign passes but task cuts conflict.
claim_rules.ONLINE_VLA_TRANSFER: NOT_TESTED unless a separate development-only online qualification is completed under this reduced checkpoint.

heldout_access: Exactly once after checkpoint selection lock and evaluator hash freeze
